newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland's Kone says profits plunge.
newsitem.headline: Finland's Kone says profits plunge.

text.p: Kone Oy, a leading international elevator and escalator manufacturer, said Thursday its profits plunged 79 percent and it forecast near-zero net earnings for 1996.
Reporting January-August earnings after extraordinary items, Kone said its net income fell to 14 million markka ($3.1 million) from 66 million ($14.4 million) a year ago.
It said total sales in the January-August period rose 7 percent to 6.01 billion markka ($1.33 billion).
Kone said new elevator and escalator sales accounted for about 34 percent of total revenues, with maintenance and modernisation making up the remainder.
The company had warned in September that it expected near-zero earnings for 1996 due to problems in its Italian operations, where losses would approach 200 million markka ($43.8 million) for 1996.

"Correcting these problems is proving more costly and time-consuming than was originally anticipated," Kone said. "Measures currently being implemented are expected to return Kone's Italian operations to profitability during 1997."
